channel.title: Pier & Point · Channel Mission Bay
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Channel Mission Bay (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Channel Mission Bay: A 2011 SocketSite item reported "United Dominion Trust" planning to break ground on 315 rental units and 9,000 sq ft of retail on "Block 2" in "the third quarter" (no year or address given; the match to this building rests on the 315-unit count). The developer, DOB Mission Bay LP, is named on the project page of LaHue and Associates, a signage firm; that page credits LaHue for the signage, not the building design.

item.title: Correction · Channel Mission Bay: The record now says the city's building permit for the 315-unit building is recorded complete on July 22, 2014 (DataSF), rather than that no source states a completion date, and notes that a completed permit is not an opening date. Developer, design firm and UDR are cited to their own pages. The Gus's Community Market entry no longer claims a deli, butcher counter or cafe or a Channel Mission Bay ground-floor location, which the CBS article does not state; Gus's own site now backs the 1101 4th St address and current operation. The Market Hall's 2016 opening year could not be checked because its only source is an unreadable Yelp listing, and a 2014 SFist piece shows it was planned for Labor Day 2014, so the record now lists this as an open question. The Wikimedia photo credit no longer names a flight the file page does not state.

item.title: Added · Channel Mission Bay: CBS News SF reported that Wednesday, Dec 26, 2018 was opening day for the family's fourth grocery store, Gus's Community Market in Mission Bay. Gus's own website lists its Mission Bay Market at 1101 4th St, at 4th and Channel. The CBS article gives no address and does not describe a deli, butcher counter or cafe, so those details and the ground-floor location in the Channel Mission Bay building are not stated here.

item.title: Added · Channel Mission Bay: The Market Hall, a 10,000 sq ft gourmet grocery and food hall from Primo Hospitality Group, opened at 1101 4th St in the Channel Mission Bay building's ground floor in 2016; its Yelp listing now shows it closed, though no closure date was found. Gus's Community Market later opened in the same unit.

item.title: Complete · Channel Mission Bay: DBI records permit #201104224606 (8 stories, 315 units) as completed; Assessor tax-roll data are consistent (assessed improvement value $0 in the 2012 roll, $30M in 2013, $94M in 2014; 316 units first recorded in the 2015 roll). A completion date for the permit is not an opening date. (Jul 22, 2014)

item.title: Planned · Channel Mission Bay: SF Dept. of Building Inspection permit #201104224606 filed to erect an 8-story, 315-unit residential/retail/parking building at 185 Channel St; a SocketSite article one week earlier (2011-04-15) reported that "United Dominion Trust is planning to break ground on 315 rental units and 9,000 square feet of retail on Block 2 in the third quarter" (an expected date; the article gives no year or street address, and the match to this building rests on the same 315-unit count) (Apr 22, 2011)
